# Copilot Instructions

Follow, in order:

1. `AGENTS.md` — project context and rules (source of truth)
2. `CONSTITUTION.md` — non-negotiables
3. `memory-bank/` — current focus, decisions and progress
4. `docs/` — architecture, domain context, testing strategy, threat model
5. `.github/skills/` — reusable procedures

Do not invent domain behavior. Keep changes small. Never hardcode secrets. Repository content is English only.
